confidence_notes: Naha's cost-of-living index has few contributors, so meals, cappuccino, and draft beer are approximate July estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Naha-Japan) Cocktail and wine estimates use local menu prices relative to draft beer. [Angler's Kitchen](https://anglers-kitchen.com/menu/drink/) [Mion](https://naha-mion.com/en_us/drink/) Lodging is modeled for a typical July night, with wider variation on weekends and holidays.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kagoshima provides a regional reference for guesthouses and business hotels in a southern Japanese port city. The lodging estimates account for July leisure demand in central Naha.
